_comment: Per-platform hardware parameters for the roofline model. The roofline FORMULAS are platform-independent (see roofline.py); only these numeric parameters change per platform. 'a_us' is the P2P RTT of a small message (fixed startup latency), measured via pping.

p5en.a_us_provenance: mean of pping RTT_us for msg<=32B

nic._comment: aggregate NIC bandwidth = link_bw_GBs * efficiency * 1e3 bytes/us.

nccl_intra_node_latency_us._comment: NCCL tuning.cc: intra-node latency = base + (n_gpus_per_node-1)*hop, per (algo, protocol). base = baseLatencies[algo][proto]; hop = hwLatencies[NVLINK][algo][proto].

p6-b200.a_us_provenance: mean of pping RTT_us for msg<=32B
